scripts.ios:release: npm --prefix .. run prepare && expo run:ios --configuration Release --no-bundler
scripts.ios:device:release: npm --prefix .. run prepare && expo run:ios --device --configuration Release --no-bundler
scripts.android:release: npm --prefix .. run prepare && rm -rf android/app/build/generated/assets && expo run:android --variant release --no-bundler
scripts.android:device:release: npm --prefix .. run prepare && rm -rf android/app/build/generated/assets && expo run:android --device --variant release --no-bundler
